title: Whistleblower protections gutted from the December 2023 NDAA
summary: Steven Greer tells of Whistleblower protections gutted from the December 2023 NDAA, about 2023 at Washington, D.C., and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: and the Congress needs to enshrine in law, which they almost did in December of 23, a little over a year ago, but that got gutted in the reconciliation of the National Defense Authorization Act.

plain: Steven Greer, an activist who campaigns for UFO disclosure, says Congress needs to write protections into law for whistleblowers, insiders who come forward about secret UFO programmes. He says Congress almost did this in December 2023, with backing from the Senate Intelligence Committee, but the protections were gutted when the two chambers reconciled the National Defense Authorization Act, the yearly law that sets US military policy and budget.
